content_sections.heading: CPCL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 26 Unreserved (UR) 34 Reserved Category Total 60 Total Posts OH: Orthopedically Handicapped; MD: Multiple Disabilities. This is the 3rd attempt to fill the PwBD backlog posts; if suitable candidates from the specified disability category are unavailable, the post may be filled by PwBD candidates with other identified disabilities. Women may apply only against: CPCL02 – Jr. Engg. Asstt-IV (Mechanical) CPCL03 – Jr. Engg. Asstt-IV (Electrical) CPCL04 – Jr. Engg. Asstt-IV (Instrumentation)

content_sections.heading: Reservation & PwBD Provisions
content_sections.text: Certificates must be in the prescribed proforma for Central Government posts, clearly indicating caste, the Act/Order under which it is recognized, and the candidate's ordinary residence. OBC certificates must confirm the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer, and must be issued on or after 01.04.2026. Only communities in the Central Government's common OBC list are treated as OBC by CPCL, being a Central PSU. EWS candidates need an Income & Asset certificate as per DoPT O.M. No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) dated 31.01.2019, issued on or after 01.04.2026. No change in community status declared in the online application will be allowed later. Reservation applies on a horizontal basis, only in identified disciplines. Given the hazardous nature of refinery operations, PwBD reservation for CPCL02 (Mechanical) and CPCL03 (Electrical) is restricted to specific functional disability categories: A minimum 40% disability in the relevant category is required to claim PwBD reservation. A valid Disability Certificate issued under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017 is mandatory. Applied horizontally across all categories (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS), including disabled servicemen. Only candidates released/retired, or whose engagement period ends on or before 31.12.2026, are eligible; a release letter and self-declaration are required at joining. Ex-servicemen already in regular Government employment get age relaxation but not reservation benefit. If sufficient eligible ExSM candidates are unavailable, reserved posts may be filled by other candidates.

rows.disability_category: Physical Locomotor disability incl. Leprosy Cured, Dwarfism & Acid Attack Victims
rows.functional_disability: One Arm (OA), One Leg (OL) & Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victim, Cerebral Palsy, Leprosy Cured
Combination of Hard of Hearing with any Locomotor disability incl. Leprosy Cured

content_sections.heading: CPCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process & Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: Selection comprises a Computer Based Test (CBT) , followed by Document Verification of shortlisted candidates, and a qualifying Skill, Proficiency and/or Physical Test (SPPT) . Objective, multiple-choice questions; total CBT duration 2 hours . Negative marking: ¼ mark deducted for each wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks: 40% in CBT for General/OBC/EWS; relaxed by 5% (i.e. 35%) for SC/ST/PwBD candidates against reserved positions. Candidates are shortlisted for SPPT in a ratio of approximately 1:3 (three candidates per post, factoring in reserved posts); tied candidates at the cut-off are all included. SPPT is of a qualifying nature (does not carry marks toward merit). Category-wise merit list is drawn from CBT marks, considering only candidates who qualify the SPPT; final selection is subject to being found medically fit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CPCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit www.cpcl.co.in , read the instructions, tick the declaration checkbox, and click Continue . Select the post from the "Post Applying For" dropdown and complete new-user signup with basic personal details; validate your e-mail ID and mobile number via OTP. Log in using the User ID and password sent to your e-mail/mobile. Fill in Personal Details (parents' names, marital status, photo ID, addresses), then Academic Details and Work Experience (mandatory for all four posts). Upload a recent passport-size photograph (20–60 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG) and scanned signature (10–30 KB, JPG/JPEG/PNG). Upload scanned documents/certificates in PDF (60 KB–2 MB). Review all details on the Preview page, using "Edit" links to correct any section if needed. Click Proceed to Payment , accept the declaration, and click Submit — no further changes are possible after this. Complete payment via Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI (where applicable), then download the application form and payment receipt from the dashboard. Important: Each candidate may apply for only one post using a single e-mail ID and mobile number. Candidates need not send application printouts or certificate copies by post; candidature is considered purely on the strength of information declared online.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies has CPCL notified?
faq.answer: CPCL has notified 60 Non-Executive Junior Engineering Assistant-IV posts across Production, Mechanical, Electrical, and Instrumentation disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Online applications and fee payment close on 11 September 2026 at 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Upper age limit is 30 years as on 01.07.2026, with relaxation of up to 15 years for eligible reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Can women apply for all posts?
faq.answer: No. Women are not currently considered for Production (CPCL01) or shift-heavy roles; they may apply for Mechanical (CPCL02), Electrical (CPCL03), and Instrumentation (CPCL04) posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹500 for General/EWS/OBC candidates; SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: A Computer Based Test (120 marks, 2 hours), followed by Document Verification and a qualifying Skill/Proficiency/Physical Test, subject to medical fitness.

faq.question: Q7. What is the starting salary?
faq.answer: Selected candidates join the Non-Supervisory Cadre Grade IV on the IDA scale of ₹25,000–₹1,05,000, with a starting basic pay of ₹25,000.
